name: The Ritz-Carlton, Key Biscayne
positioning: Oceanfront resort on Key Biscayne, a barrier island minutes from downtown Miami, reopened in December 2025 after a $100 million renovation
best_for: Families who want separate family and adult pools
Guests who want a resort stay rather than Miami nightlife

facts.text: The resort sits on a five-mile-long barrier island, minutes from downtown Miami.
The resort reopened in December 2025 after the renovation.
Guest rooms and suites have been nearly completely redone.
Bathrooms have gold-veined marble, deep soaking tubs, separate showers and Diptyque bath products.
Every accommodation has a balcony with ocean, island or resort views.
Paralia, by the beach, serves Aegean-inspired dishes meant for sharing.
Dune Beach Bar is a no-reservations, toes-in-the-sand lounge serving burgers and ceviches.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa has sixteen treatment rooms, including couples suites, a full-service salon and several restorative lounges including a spa garden.
Ritz Kids sessions are available for resort guests ages 5 through 12.
The Ritz-Carlton Club costs extra, with a large Club Lounge serving food throughout the day and Club-level rooms on the ninth floor.

highlights.text: A $100 million renovation was completed throughout 2025, led by developer Gencom with design studios Hart Howerton, DesignAgency and Chapi Chapo Design.
Luma is an Italian grill with house-made pastas and proteins from a Josper oven, and it is the resort's signature restaurant.
The resort has two oceanfront pools: an adult pool and a zero-entry family pool with a splash pad.
The Cliff Drysdale Racquet Garden offers tennis, padel and pickleball courts, and the resort has a long-standing connection to tennis.

considerations.text: Key Biscayne is not the place for Miami nightlife or the South Beach scene; it suits guests who want resort life.
Guest rooms and suites do not have overhead lighting, so rooms can feel dark when there is no natural daylight.
The hotel does not provide shuttle service from Miami International Airport.
